notes.title: 🎮 Controller support? Finally nailed it!
notes.content: [p]With this update, "Touhou Iyuushou ~ What the Bullet Hell?!" officially supports controller input![/p][p][b]✅ Key Features:[/b] [/p][p]Full controller support for common XInput devices such as Xbox and DualShock (except for naming conventions)[/p][p]Supports customizable key bindings — whether you use keyboard or controller, you can configure controls your way[/p][p]Basic UI navigation is compatible with controllers[/p][p]Keyboard and mouse can be used simultaneously with controllers![/p][p][b]✦ In short, there are no limits to bullet hell research — play however you want![/b][/p][p]Grab your controller and challenge those gstamp levels you haven’t cleared yet![/p]
